scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.deploy:pages: sh -c 'cd artifacts/osm-leaderboard && PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/osm-leaderboard/ node_modules/.bin/vite build --config vite.config.ts && cd ../.. && rm -rf docs && mkdir docs && cp -R artifacts/osm-leaderboard/dist/public/. docs/ && touch docs/.nojekyll && echo "docs/ updated — review with git status/diff, then commit and push"'
